description: Install a skill by owner/name slug: validates it, then writes one canonical copy (.agents/skills/<name>) and links it into the chosen agents' skill directories. Never executes scripts. The response reports the skill's capability flags (docs_only, network_calls, executes_scripts, reads_secrets) as information.

agents.description: Agent ids to link the skill into (default: every agent detected on this machine)

deny.description: Refuse the skill if it carries any of these security flags

dest.description: Deprecated: an explicit agent skills directory. Must be a known agent skills dir; prefer scope + agents.

force.description: Replace a skill installed from a different source or an untracked directory

mode.description: link (junction/symlink to the canonical copy, default) or copy

scope.description: project = the current directory's agent folders (default when the cwd looks like a project); global = the user's home-level agent folders

slug.description: Skill identifier as owner/name, e.g. anthropic/pdf

name: skillmd_install

canonical.description: Absolute path of the canonical copy every target links to

note.description: Caveats, e.g. when only SKILL.md could be written

scope.description: Which set of agent folders was written

security_flags.description: Capability flags reported for the skill

skipped.description: Agents that were not written, with the reason

targets.description: Agent skill dirs the canonical copy was linked or copied into; empty when only the canonical copy was written

title: Install skill
